sql: /* Query 8: 4 (team) */ SELECT team_name, championship, location FROM team WHERE championship > 6 AND championship >= 1 AND founded_year = 1989 AND championship <= 1

championship.description: championships is the number of this team getting championships (e.g. 5).

location.description: location is the lastest city the team team located (e.g. Los Angeles).

team_name.description: team_name is the full name of the team (e.g. Los Angeles Lakers).
